title: Mortal Shell II Guide & Wiki
description: Central hub for Mortal Shell II guides, interactive map, shells, weapons, bosses, routes, and database pages.
quickAnswer: This Guides hub collects Mortal Shell II resources: Beginner Guide, Interactive Map, Shells, Weapons, Bosses, Walkthrough/Routes, NG+, Achievements, and Upgrades. Use the authority cards below to jump to the page you need.

faq.question: Where can I find the Beginner Guide?
faq.answer: The Beginner Guide is linked from this hub at /mortal-shell-ii/beginner-guide/ and is the recommended starting point.

faq.question: Is there an interactive map for Mortal Shell II?
faq.answer: Yes — open the Interactive Map at /mortal-shell-ii/map/ from the hub to locate shells, bosses, and notable sites.

faq.question: Where are the Shells and Weapons references?
faq.answer: Shells and Weapons are documented in the hub at /mortal-shell-ii/shells/ and /mortal-shell-ii/weapons/ respectively.

faq.question: Does the hub link to boss and route information?
faq.answer: Yes — Bosses are grouped at /mortal-shell-ii/bosses/ and world-progression routes are at /mortal-shell-ii/routes/world-progression/.

faq.question: Where can I read about NG+ and Tarforge upgrades?
faq.answer: NG+ guidance is at /mortal-shell-ii/new-game-plus/ and Tarforge/Upgrades are covered at /mortal-shell-ii/tarforge/.

articleMarkdown:
Welcome — this Guides hub is the central gateway to Mortal Shell II help: concise how-tos, the interactive map, shell and weapon database pages, boss references, routes and progression, NG+, trophies, and Tarforge upgrades.

Quick links

- Beginner Guide — /mortal-shell-ii/beginner-guide/
- Interactive Map — /mortal-shell-ii/map/
- Shells — /mortal-shell-ii/shells/
- Weapons — /mortal-shell-ii/weapons/
- Bosses — /mortal-shell-ii/bosses/
- Walkthrough / Routes — /mortal-shell-ii/routes/world-progression/
- Achievements — /mortal-shell-ii/trophies/
- NG+ — /mortal-shell-ii/new-game-plus/
- Upgrades (Tarforge) — /mortal-shell-ii/tarforge/

[IMAGE: Hub overview screenshot placeholder]

Authority cards (use these to jump)

- Beginner Guide — /mortal-shell-ii/beginner-guide/ — Start here for early-game tips and recommended first steps.
- Interactive Map — /mortal-shell-ii/map/ — Full, clickable world map for locations and points of interest.
- Shells — /mortal-shell-ii/shells/ — Reference list of shells and where to find them.
- Weapons — /mortal-shell-ii/weapons/ — Weapon stats, locations, and overview.
- Bosses — /mortal-shell-ii/bosses/ — Boss pages and summaries.
- Walkthrough / Routes — /mortal-shell-ii/routes/world-progression/ — Suggested world-progression routes and route planning.
- Achievements — /mortal-shell-ii/trophies/ — Trophy and achievement checklist.
- NG+ — /mortal-shell-ii/new-game-plus/ — New Game+ notes and considerations.
- Upgrades (Tarforge) — /mortal-shell-ii/tarforge/ — Tarforge upgrade pages and related info.

How to use this hub

1. New players: open the Beginner Guide (/mortal-shell-ii/beginner-guide/) first. It is the recommended starting point linked from the homepage and Guides hub.
2. Use the Interactive Map (/mortal-shell-ii/map/) to locate shells, bosses, and upgrade resources as you follow a route.
3. Consult Shells (/mortal-shell-ii/shells/) and Weapons (/mortal-shell-ii/weapons/) pages when choosing builds.
4. Follow the Walkthrough / Routes (/mortal-shell-ii/routes/world-progression/) for suggested progression order and to find key areas in sequence.
5. When preparing for replay or late-game, read NG+ (/mortal-shell-ii/new-game-plus/) and Tarforge (/mortal-shell-ii/tarforge/).

Suggested route (fast reference)

1. Read the Beginner Guide (/mortal-shell-ii/beginner-guide/).
2. Open the Interactive Map (/mortal-shell-ii/map/) and mark your immediate objectives.
3. Prioritize a shell and a weapon page to focus your build (/mortal-shell-ii/shells/, /mortal-shell-ii/weapons/).
4. Use the Routes page (/mortal-shell-ii/routes/world-progression/) to follow a world-progression plan.
5. Consult Bosses (/mortal-shell-ii/bosses/) before major fights.

Common mistakes

- Skipping the Beginner Guide: many early-game questions are covered there — start with it to avoid confusion.
- Ignoring the map: locations matter for progression and upgrades; use /mortal-shell-ii/map/.
- Jumping between sources without a route: pick a world-progression route on /mortal-shell-ii/routes/world-progression/ and follow it.

Related hub relationships (site graph)

- The homepage links to the Beginner Guide, Skip Prologue (see homepage links), Shells, Weapons, Map, and Routes.
- The Guides list includes Magdalena and Bosses; Magdalena pages also cross-link to Bosses and specific world routes.
- Beta Carry Over, Skip Prologue, and the Beginner Guide are connected in the guide network (see the Beginner Guide and homepage links).

If you can't find a page listed in the cards, check the Guides index on the site; the hub groups existing guides by topic and adds direct links to the most-used pages.
